quote: The angels surround and help the priest when he is celebrating Mass. - St Augustine
When Mass is being celebrated, the sanctuary is filled with countless angels who adore the Divine Victim immolated on the altar. - St John Chrysostom
It would be easier for the world to survive without the sun than to do without Holy Mass. - St Pio of Pietrelcina

I often think that when we come to adore Our Lord in the Blessed Sacrament we obtain all blessings from Him; but when He wishes to show mercy to a soul, does He not choose as His messenger an angel, or someone dear to that soul, to carry consolation to it? I think so, for Our Saviour's delight is to be alone with the soul He loves. - St Therese of Lisieux

When you are before the altar where Christ reposes, you ought no longer to think that you are amongst men; but believe that there are troops of angels and archangels standing by you, and trembling with respect before the sovereign Master of Heaven and earth. Therefore, when you are in church, be there in silence, fear, and veneration. - St John Chrysostom
If we could see Him as He is, we should die of love. - St John Vianney
The Angels, if they were capable of envy, would envy us for two things: one is the receiving of Holy Communion, and the other is suffering. - St Faustina Kowalska
Invoke your Guardian Angel, who will enlighten you and guide you. God has given him to you for your protection, therefore, you should use him. - St Pio of Pietrelcina

Have you seen a large field full of wheat in spring, when it is so light a breath of wind makes it undulate in long waves which pass rapidly over its surface, so that one moment it is green, the next golden? That is what happens in this sublime ceremony of the Mass; one moment you see bread, the next it is the Body of Jesus Christ; the Angels are there all around; for, as man is always accompanied by his guardian angel, the Angels must be incomparably more numerous at the Mass than the men, since each one of us brings his guardian angel with him. - St John Vianney
The angels surround and help the priest when he is celebrating Mass. - St Augustine
We ought to ask the Blessed Virgin, the angels, and the saints to pray for us that we may receive the good God as worthily as it is possible for us to receive him. - St John Mary Vianney

God's Providence has given Angeles the mission of guarding the human race to help every man [...]. They have been designated from birth to our care, and formed to defend the salvation of individual men. - Roman Catechism
After thanking our guardian angel who has remained by our side during our sleep, we should ask him for his protection during the day. - St John Mary Vianney

I know you will be glad to have this prayer to the holy guardian Angels of our Tabernacles: O Angelic Spirits that guard our Tabernacles, wherein lies the adorable treasure of the holy Eucharist, defend it from profanation and preserve it for our love. - St. Josemaría

With what humility should we assist at Mass, if we realized that our guardian angel was kneeling beside us, prostrate before the majesty of God! With what eagerness should we not ask him to offer our prayers to Jesus Christ! - St John Mary Vianney
(The guardian angel) watches over us, tireless and carefully - St. Bernard
Like the saints, let us be very zealous in fulfilling all our duties; let the Devil never find us doing nothing, lest we should yield to temptation. - St John Mary Vianney
How many moments can be lost in doing nothing, or in doing wrong, in listening to the suggestions of the Devil, or in obeying him! - St John Mary Vianney

Never forget that it is at the beginning of each day that God has the necessary grace for the day ready for us. He knows exactly what opportunities we shall have to sin ...and will give us everything we need if we ask him then. That is why the Devil does all he can to prevent us from saying our Morning Prayers or to make us say them badly. - St John Mary Vianney

Men can ignore the inspirations that give good angels invisibly, enlightening to do good, but free will remains intact: hence the missing men should not be attributed to the negligence of the angels, but the malice of men - St. Thomas Aquinas
What a comfort to you it is to know that when we go out of the house, we are never alone en route. - St John Mary Vianney

They are the ambassadors of God with men, and the ambassadors of men with God. Not only are the angels of God, but also the angels of men. Angels, meaning “sent”: are therefore the angels of God because He sends them to assist us, and they are the angels of men, because we resend them to get mercy. They come to us laden with gifts, returning laden with our promises; they descend to lead us, and they go up to bring God our desires and our good works. - Bosuet

When we are walking in the streets, let us fix our eyes on our Lord bearing his Cross before us; on the Blessed Virgin who is looking at us; on our Guardian Angel who is by our side. - St John Mary Vianney

Angels, in addition to carrying God our news, bringing the aid of God to our souls and, as good shepherds, they care with sweet communications and divine inspirations. God uses them to communicate with us. Angels defend us from the wolves, who are the demons and protect us. - St. John of the Cross

When you awake in the night, transport yourself quickly in spirit before the Tabernacle, saying: "Behold me, my God, I come to adore you, to praise, thank, and love you, and to keep you company with all the Angels. - St John Mary Vianney

He sends his angels around you, says the Psalm, to keep thee in all thy ways. That is why we have to watch more carefully, because there would not be such demand for us in heaven if w were not in such a need. There would not be so many keepers if there were not so many ambushes. - St. Bernard
We must watch over our mind, our heart and our senses, for these are the gates by which the Devil enters in. - St John Mary Vianney

Christian tradition describes the guardian angels as powerful friends, placed by God alongside each one of us, to accompany us on our way. And that is why he invites us to make friends with them and get them to help us. - St. Josemaría
If you feel sweetness or compunction at some word of your prayer, dwell on it; for then our guardian angel is praying with us. - St. John Climacus

If we did like St. Remigius, we should never be angry. See, this saint, being questioned by a Father of the desert as to how he managed to be always in an even temper, replied: " I often consider that my guardian angel is always by my side... - St John Mary Vianney

The angel who is always near us is by nothing so distressed and made indignant as when, without being constrained by some necessity, we deprive ourselves of the ministration of the Holy Mysteries and of reception of Holy Communion, which grants remission of sins. For at that hour the priest offers up the sacrifice of the Body of Him Who gives us life, and the Holy Spirit descends and consecrates the Body and Blood and grants remission to creation. The Cherubim, the Seraphim, and the angels stand with great awe, fear, and joy. They rejoice over the Holy Mysteries while experiencing inexpressible astonishment. The angel who is always by us is consoled, because he also partakes in that spectacle and is not deprived of that perfect intercourse. - St. Isaac the Syrian
If we could only see the JOY of our guardian angel when he sees us fighting our temptations! - St John Mary Vianney

When you close the doors to your dwelling and are alone you should know that there is present with you the angel whom God has appointed for each man...This angel, who is sleepless and cannot be deceived, is always present with you; he sees all things and is not hindered by darkness. You should know, too, that with him is God, who is in every place; for there is no place and nothing material in which God is not, since He is greater than all things and holds all men in His hand. - St. Antony the Great
All the angels and saints are engaged in trying to prevent us from committing sins. - St John Mary Vianney
Since God often sends us inspirations by means of His angels, we should frequently return our aspirations to him by means of the same messengers. - St. Francis De Sales
Always remember that you are in the presence of your guardian angel…Never do in the presence of your guardian angel what you would not do in my presence. - St. Bernard
Never travel faster than your guardian angel can fly. - St Teresa of Calcutta

We should show our affection for the angels, for one day they will be our co-heirs just as here below they are our guardians and trustees appointed and set over us by the Father. - St Bernard of Clairvaux
The servants of Christ are protected by invisible, rather than visible, beings. But if these guard you, they do so because they have been summoned by your prayers. - St. Ambrose

The powers of hell will assail the dying Christian; but his angel guardian will come to console him. His patrons, and St. Michael, who has been appointed by God to defend his faithful servants in their last combat with the devils, will come to his aid. - St Alphonsus Liguori
How happy is that guardian angel who accompanies a soul to Holy Mass! - St John Vianney
Beside each believer stands an Angel as protector and shepherd, leading him to life. - St Basil the Great
If we only knew how God regards this Sacrifice, we would risk our lives to be present at a single Mass. - St Pio of Pietrelcina
It is by far the most sublime of all creations. - St John Chrysostom
When you are at Holy Mass, be attentive to the Mystery being enacted. For it is the same as that enacted on Calvary. - St Pio of Pietrelcina

The Mass is infinite like Jesus...Ask an angel what the Mass is, and he will reply truly in substance,'I understand what it is and why it is offered, but I do not, however, understand how much value it has.' One angel, a thousand angels, all of Heaven, know this and think like this. - St Pio of Pietrelcina
The heavens open and multitudes of angels come to assist in the Holy Sacrifice of the Mass. - St Gregory the Great
How happy is that guardian angel who accompanies a soul to Holy Mass! - St John Vianney

When we go before the Blessed Sacrament, let us open our heart; our good God will open His. We shall go to Him; He will come to us; the one to ask, the other to receive. It will be like a breath from one to the other. - St John Vianney

The Holy Mass is a prayer itself, even the highest prayer that exists. It is the Sacrifice dedicated by our Redeemer at the Cross, and repeated every day on the Altar. If you wish to hear Mass as it should be heard, you must follow with eye, heart, and mouth all that happens at the Altar. Further, you must pray with the priest the holy words said by him in the Name of Christ and which Christ says by him. You have to associate your heart with the holy feelings which are contained in these words and in this manner you ought to follow all that happens at the Altar. When acting in this way you have prayed Holy Mass. - Pope St Pius X
When we receive Holy Communion, we experience something extraordinary – a joy, a fragrance, a well being that thrills the whole body and causes it to exult. - St John Vianney
If we really understood the Mass, we would die of joy. - St John Vianney
There is nothing so great as the Eucharist. If God had something more precious, He would have given it to us. - St John Vianney
When we have been to Holy Communion, the balm of love envelops the soul as the flower envelops the bee. - St John Vianney

The many wonders of creation can only fill us with astonishment and admiration. But when we speak of the most holy Eucharist we can say that here is to be found the miracle of divine love for us... Has there been, or will there ever be, a nobler or more magnanimous love than that? - St John Vianney
I throw myself at the foot of the Tabernacle like a dog at the foot of his Master. - St John Vianney

All the good works in the world are not equal to the Holy Sacrifice of the Mass because they are the works of men; but the Mass is the work of God. Martyrdom is nothing in comparison for it is but the sacrifice of man to God; but the Mass is the sacrifice of God for man. - St John Vianney
We should consider those moments spent before the Blessed Sacrament as the happiest of our lives. - St John Vianney
Paradise, especially in these times, is made up of all those who love and esteem the priesthood. - St John Vianney
I tell you that you have made our Lord into a host in the tabernacle, but if you knew what He is in Heaven, you would see the difference. - St John Vianney
If we knew the value of the Holy Sacrifice of the Mass, how much greater effort we would put into going to Mass. - St John Vianney
The virtue of obedience makes the will supple... It gives the power to conquer self, to overcome laziness and to resist temptations. - St John Vianney
The first end I propose in our daily work is to do the will of God; secondly, to do it in the manner he wills it; and thirdly to do it because it is his will. - St Elizabeth Ann Seton
The angels take great pleasure in helping us with our enterprises, when they are in accordance with God's will. - St Ignatius of Loyola
Make the guardian angels your best friends, faithful friends who are always ready to listen to your prayers. - St John Bosco
See that you do not despise one of these little ones; for I tell you that in heaven their angels always behold the face of my Father who is in heaven. - Matthew 18:10
The guardian angels of life fly so high as to be beyond our sight, but they are always looking down upon us. - St Jean-Marie Vianney
Our guardian angels are our most faithful friends, because they are with us day and night, always and everywhere. We ought often to invoke them. - St John Mary Vianney
We know by faith that angels exist and read that appeared to many, so it is not lawful to doubt it. - St. Augustine
Almost every page of the sacred books testify that there are angels and archangels. - St. Gregory the Great
There is not a single creature which does not provide us with the means of reaching God. If any of them become an obstacle, it is only by our misuse of them. - St John Mary Vianney

All men have beside them two angels, one good and one bad. Thus the Scripture tells. Regarding the good angels, the Saviour tells us: Do not despise any of these little ones: I tell you that their angels always see the face of my Father who is in heaven (Mt 18, 10). To them also makes reference the following word: He will send the angel of the Lord to those who fear him, and will save them (Psalm 33, 8). And in the Acts of the Apostles, concerning Peter: Because it's his angel(Acts 12, 15). - Cassian
